interface.signature: width: int, height: int, x_coords: List[int], y_coords: List[int] -> List[List[int]]

preconditions.description: The width and height of the map must be positive integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < width for x in x_coords) and all(0 <= y < height for y in y_coords)
preconditions.description: All x and y coordinates of supply points must be within the bounds of the map.
The number of x coordinates must match the number of y coordinates.

postconditions.description: If no supply points are provided, the output must be a 2D array filled with None.
postconditions.expression: return_value == [[None for _ in range(width)] for _ in range(height)]

postconditions.description: The output must be a 2D array with the correct number of rows and columns.
postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) and len(row) == width for row in return_value)

postconditions.description: Each cell in the output must be an integer or None.
postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cell, int) or cell is None for row in return_value for cell in row)
